name: Reference after the verse
about: A reference on the line after a verse attaches to that verse; verse numbers off takes the numbers the reference names out of the words, and Fit to box splits a verse too long for the box at its sentences, the reference on the last slide's last line (never alone), with no blank inside the passage.

runs.text: 1 Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, 2 but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night. 3 He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
